# Genes

> Genes is a single Markdown specification (genes.md) that coding LLMs read to generate
> dependency-free PHP websites that run on ordinary $5 shared hosting.

Give genes.md to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot or another coding AI, describe the
site, and it generates a consistent project: one index.php entry point, URL routing,
multi-language content in JSON, an optional SQLite database with a CMS admin
dashboard, a fixed three-breakpoint responsive layout, SEO metadata and security
defaults. Deploy by uploading the folder with FTP. No Node.js, Composer or build step.

## Specification

- [genes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devrimvardar/genes/main/genes.md): the full specification to give to an LLM
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/devrimvardar/genes): source, license (MIT) and this website

## Example

- [Corporate example (.zip)](https://genes.one/downloads/genes-corporate-example.zip): a complete three-language corporate site with SQLite news, an admin, and a contact form, generated from genes.md

## Pages

- [Documentation](https://genes.one/en/docs): how the specification is structured
- [Examples](https://genes.one/en/examples): what you can build with it
- [Download](https://genes.one/en/download): how to start a project
